user.title: Your Docbee Connect
user.description: Enter your DocBee instance URL and an access token with permission to read users, queues, priorities and tickets.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew DocBee access token
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a valid access token with permission to read users, queues, priorities and tickets.

init.title: Priority 1 selection
init.description: Select one or more priorities for counts and events. IDs survive renaming. An empty selection uses the legacy numeric value 100. Saving reloads the connection without events for existing tickets.
